items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: The interviewee discusses 'Joe' (Joe Pass) extensively, admiring his style. 'Tiger' is mentioned only by the interviewer in a parenthetical remark ('hold that Tiger') which the interviewee does not address or acknowledge as a person they know.

ctx.x: Uh, where he would, uh, roar or yell.
Yeah, well, he, but he'd pull, when it came to hold that Tiger, he'd pull up a Christmas horn and blow it. That was really great.

I tell you, anybody, anybody that did see Joe in action, to me, Joe was the typical old, old, old time jazz musician. He just didn't care. He just wanted to play music. And, uh, I don't know, I've always admired Joe. I like Joe. I like his style. I like the way, maybe I, I would never think of action. I would never think of acting the way Joe acted on a bandstand, you understand? But, I mean, you had to appreciate what he was doing. Everything he did was just part of the show, you know?
